== Biography ==
'''Boyd Glasgow''' was born about 1834 or 1835 in County Antrim, Ireland. He entered Ballymena Workhouse from Glenleslie on 3 June 1847, aged twelve, with Mary, William James, Mary Jane and Margaret Glasgow. He was discharged alive on 31 July.<ref name="Workhouse1847">[https://www.billmacafee.com/otherrecords/ballymenaworkhouse.pdf William Macafee, "Admissions to Ballymena Workhouse: 13th May to 8th July 1847"], registrations 4406–4410 (accessed 13 August 2026).</ref>

The mortality portion of the surviving 1851 Ballycregagh census calls Boyde a sixteen-year-old son of [[Glasgow-2981|James Glasgow]] and states that he died in winter 1847.<ref name="Census1851">1851 Census of Ireland, County Antrim, Dunaghy parish, Ballycraigargh, household 29, James Glasgow household: [https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/3:1:3QSQ-G94X-YD22 living household, image 251] and [https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/3:1:3QS7-L94X-Y621 continuation and mortality return, image 252].</ref>

== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-2981]] is assessed at 99% (proved). The held 1851 mortality return explicitly calls Boyde a sixteen-year-old son of James, dying in winter 1847. Boyd’s 1847 Glenleslie workhouse admission at twelve and July discharge provide compatible independent context before his death.

Held 1851 census relationship quotation/summary and existing source citations establish the census-defined child’s father; no fresh image inspection or adult identity extension.

Next useful test: Compare the original mortality and workhouse rows.

Source basis already held: [https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/3:1:3QSQ-G94X-YD22 1851 Census of Ireland, County Antrim, Dunaghy parish, Ballycraigargh, household 29, James Glasgow household: living household, image 251 (https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/3:1:3QSQ-G94X-YD22) and continuation and mortality return, image 252 (https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/3:1:3QS7-L94X-Y621).]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.



=== Parentage ===

The census directly proves James as Boyd's father. [[Hamilton-25516|Peggy Hamilton]] remains attached as an uncertain working mother because no better-supported replacement profile has been identified. Peggy's reported 1848 marriage to James occurred after Boyd's death, so she should not be treated as his proved mother; however, the marriage date does not make earlier biological maternity impossible. [[Unknown-764460|Mary]] in the 1847 workhouse family is the stronger candidate, although no marriage or baptism naming both parents has been found.

The County Antrim birth and death places in the structured fields are useful uncertain estimates based on the Glenleslie workhouse entry and Ballycregagh mortality return; neither record states a more exact place.

The former National Archives of Ireland household URL for this cited source was unavailable (connection timed out) when checked 26 August 2026. The source identity and household details are retained in the 1851 census citation above.
